title: Paradise Park Resort

services.name: Our Campground
services.desc: Paradise Park Resort is a family campground located on forty wooded acres which features our very own 5-acre bass pond. In addition to 239 campsites, we also have a 1600 sq. ft. recreation tent where campers can enjoy nightly movies. Our friendly staff can assist you with any of your needs, whether you are tenting or towing an R.V. We've got the perfect site waiting for you! We are only 800 feet from downtown Old Orchard Beach where you can enjoy the pier, shopping, amusements and miles of golden sand.
